correctness.rationale: Exact rotation recurrence yields G=gcd(N,(b^m−1)D) with both divisibility directions. Möbius inversion counts m-digit integers coprime to M with error at most 2^omega(M); strings of nonunit digit gcd are bounded by a fixed-base exponentially smaller count. Prime-index cyclotomic factors have order ell and reciprocals totaling o(1), giving each prescribed positive subsequential limit. Divergence of reciprocal primes along multiplicative-order multiples forces liminf zero. Absolute asymptotic upper bound is phi(b−1)/(b−1). Standalone checker exhaustively validated 235455 strings; infinite claim follows only from proof.
